name: Annette
description: A roaming support mage who shapes fights with wind zones, shields and a protective barrier that disrupts nearby enemies.
guide: ["Place wind zones across enemy approaches and reserve Hurricane Wall to protect allies when opponents commit."]

name: Ata
description: A durable tank for Clash Lane or Jungle who recovers buffered health through damage and creates terrain with Ghost Ship.
guide: ["Use Ghost Ship to restrict movement when allied damage dealers are close enough to follow your initiation."]

name: Butterfly
description: A Jungle fighter whose takedown marks and ultimate resets let her move rapidly between weakened enemies.
guide: ["Enter after enemy defensive abilities are spent, then use successful takedowns to continue the fight."]

name: Devara
description: A Clash Lane fighter who builds energy through basic attacks, combining thunder dashes, shields and displacement.
guide: ["Accumulate energy first, then combine Thunderblaze with Divine Judgment before extending combat with Millennium Echo."]

name: Fatih
description: A fighter for Clash Lane or Jungle who follows skills with healing sword attacks and empowers them through Sacred Tree Blessing.
guide: ["Alternate skills with enhanced basic attacks to use their healing, and time your ultimate to remove crowd control."]

name: Florentino
description: A mobile Clash Lane duelist who collects bouquets to empower attacks, recover health and refresh his follow-up strikes.
guide: ["Collect Blossom bouquets between attacks and use the follow-up dashes to maintain your Triple Threat sequence."]

name: Flowborn (Assassin)
description: Flowborn's Jungle assassin form uses dual claws and Flow-based resets to chain movement and enhanced attacks.

name: Flowborn (Mage)
description: Flowborn's Mid mage form spends Flow on enhanced attacks and overlapping magic circles that damage and control enemies.
guide: ["Repeat Flow Formation to strengthen its control effects and overlap circles to extend their duration."]

name: Flowborn (Roamer)
description: Flowborn's roaming support form uses a Guqin platform and empowered attacks that bounce between enemies or restore health.

name: Flowborn (Tank)
description: Flowborn's Clash Lane tank form adapts its Flow state and combines healing attacks, shields and launching strikes.
guide: ["Choose a Flow state at base and coordinate your crowd control with teammates who can immediately follow up."]

name: Garuda
description: A Mid mage with piercing attacks, persistent arrow formations and movement tools for ranged pressure.
guide: ["Wear opponents down from a safe distance before moving into a committed fight."]

name: Lapulapu
description: A roaming support who strengthens a vulnerable ally's defenses and disrupts enemies with dashes and fractured ground.
guide: ["Save your launching abilities to interrupt an enemy who commits onto a teammate."]

name: Lorion
description: A Mid mage who controls a movable orb, using its position for area damage, levitation and repositioning.
guide: ["Place the orb before enemies group up, then keep a safe route for your movement toward it."]

name: Luara
description: A Farm marksman whose serpent blades enhance attacks and reduce Deadly Fang's cooldown, with movement that can cross walls.
guide: ["Deal damage from behind allied frontliners and keep your escape options available when enemies attempt to dive."]

name: Agudo
description: A Jungle marksman who releases monsters for blessings, summons companions and sends Furball into combat independently.
guide: ["Collect monster blessings with Release and use Wild Growth to support your summons before sending Furball forward."]

name: Alessio
description: A Farm marksman who fires explosive area attacks, creates protective smoke and prolongs airborne movement through basic attacks.
guide: ["Preserve enough mana for the main fight and position behind teammates while keeping an escape available."]

name: Allain
description: A Clash Lane fighter who builds Fury through attacks and skills to gain penetration, damage reduction and healing.
guide: ["Wait for opposing crowd control to be used before committing your dash and sustained attacks."]

name: Angela
description: A Mid mage who combines fireball control with repeated skill hits and a channeled beam protected by a shield.
guide: ["Aim Chaos Cinder to stun a target before channeling Blazing Brilliance into that target."]

name: Ao'yin
description: A Farm marksman whose recent Dragon Soul elements change his attacks, combining damage, recovery and movement effects.
guide: ["Keep allied protection between you and divers while selecting Dragon Souls for the effects your next attacks need."]

name: Arke
description: A Jungle assassin whose attacks from behind always critically strike, with stealth and takedown-based cooldown refreshes.
guide: ["Approach from behind after enemy control abilities are spent, then use takedowns to refresh your skills."]

name: Arli
description: A mobile Farm marksman who builds attack marks, gains bonuses while her parasol is away and can deflect projectiles.
guide: ["Delay your commitment until enemy control is spent and preserve room to reposition around your allied frontline."]

name: Arthur
description: A fighter tank for Clash Lane or Jungle who regenerates health, silences targets and launches enemies with Excalibur.
guide: ["Use Valiant Charge to silence a priority target when teammates are ready to follow with damage."]

name: Athena
description: A Jungle fighter assassin whose shielded dashes provide control immunity and empower close-range spear attacks.
guide: ["Watch enemy crowd-control cooldowns and time your shielded movement before committing to a target."]

name: Augran
description: A Jungle or Clash Lane fighter who sustains soul-linked damage and traverses terrain along a path to the afterlife.
guide: ["Wait out key defensive abilities before pursuing a target and maintain your soul connection while dealing damage."]

name: Bai Qi
description: A Clash Lane tank who gains energy through combat, restores health and uses a leaping taunt to initiate.
guide: ["Aim your taunt at valuable targets only when allied damage dealers can capitalize on the control."]

name: Biron
description: A Clash Lane fighter who builds charge to strengthen healing strikes, launching attacks and protective shields.
guide: ["Build charge through hits before using the enhanced skill needed for your next trade or initiation."]

name: Cai Yan
description: A roaming support whose songs heal teammates, strengthen an endangered ally's defenses and bounce stuns between enemies.
guide: ["Stay within reach of your carry and time healing for the enemy's actual damage window."]

name: Chano
description: A Farm or Jungle marksman who gains attack bonuses from brush, sets wolf traps and can attack while moving.
guide: ["Use brush for the enhanced opening attack and enter larger fights after enemy defensive abilities are committed."]

name: Charlotte
description: A fighter for Clash Lane or Jungle who chains different skills into enhanced follow-ups and stronger basic attacks.
guide: ["Land one skill before changing to another, building marks for an enhanced attack while enemies' control is unavailable."]

name: Chicha
description: A versatile fighter for Clash Lane, Jungle or Farm who changes weapons through basic attacks and combines movement with recovery.
guide: ["Hold your commitment until the initial exchange has drawn out enemy defenses, then continue through your weapon forms."]

name: Cirrus
description: A Jungle assassin who ignores terrain after level four, punishes moving targets and carries an enemy airborne.
guide: ["Use terrain freedom to approach after opposing control is spent, then follow your team's initial engagement."]

name: Consort Yu
description: A Farm marksman with long-range bolts, a temporary physical-damage immunity and a retreating stun shot.
guide: ["Keep mana and Protecting Winds available for the enemy's approach instead of exhausting resources on poke."]

name: Da Qiao
description: A support mage for Roam or Mid who creates damaging tides and portals that transport teammates across the map.
guide: ["Use Sea of Fate for a teammate's return trip and Eye of the Whirlpool when allies need to join your position."]

name: Daji
description: A Mid mage who lowers magical defense with skill hits and combines targeted control with multi-hit burst.
guide: ["Focus an isolated enemy so Heartbreaker's repeated hits are concentrated on the intended target."]

name: Dharma
description: A fighter for Clash Lane or Jungle who gains defenses through skills and can drive enemies into walls.
guide: ["Line up Truth Mantra with nearby terrain so the knockback produces its additional damage and stun."]

name: Di Renjie
description: A Farm marksman whose repeated attacks build speed, with token skills that cleanse debuffs and weaken enemy defenses.
guide: ["Preserve Legal Immunity for incoming debuffs and keep enough resources to fight from behind allied protection."]

name: Dian Wei
description: A Jungle fighter who can cleanse control with skills and gains attack speed and lifesteal through Outburst.
guide: ["Follow the opening engagement and land Outburst on an enemy to gain its stronger combat bonuses."]

name: Diaochan
description: A Mid or Clash Lane mage who stacks fragrance marks for area damage and healing while repeatedly dashing.
guide: ["Fight within Flowery Potential to accelerate your basic skill cooldowns and maintain mark detonations."]

name: Dolia
description: A roaming support who heals allies in water and resets a teammate's longest active skill cooldown.
guide: ["Stay near your chosen covenant partner and time Celestial Melody after their important skill enters cooldown."]

name: Donghuang
description: A support tank for Roam or Clash Lane who sustains through orbiting dark orbs and suppresses a target with shared damage.
guide: ["Keep teammates ready before using Forsaken Contract so they can act during the suppression window."]

name: Dr Bian
description: A Mid mage whose poison marks damage enemies over time while allied marks provide sustained healing.
guide: ["Apply marks before Master of Life to strengthen its damage and healing, while keeping nearby allies in reach."]

name: Dun
description: A tank for Clash Lane or Roam who sustains at low health and combines shields, launches and true-damage attacks.
guide: ["Land Wind Slash to unlock its follow-up launch, then time your engagement for allied damage."]

name: Dyadia
description: A roaming support who links allies for recovery and movement, while marking enemies to reveal and pressure them.
guide: ["Keep linked teammates close enough to activate their shared recovery and movement benefits during incoming damage."]

name: Erin
description: A Farm marksman who builds Energy and Laurels through attacks, gaining movement and empowered shots before her ultimate.
guide: ["Accumulate Laurels through your attack cycle and keep allied frontliners between you and approaching enemies."]

name: Fang
description: A Farm or Jungle marksman who reveals nearby enemies, stacks explosive target marks and escapes with an untargetable dash.
guide: ["Attack the marked target to build its explosion and preserve Wheel Away for enemy commitment."]

name: Feyd
description: A Jungle assassin who travels along natural walls, enhances attacks and marks weakened opponents for a finishing strike.
guide: ["Approach along walls and wait for opposing control abilities to be used before starting your attack sequence."]

name: Flowborn (Marksman)
description: Flowborn's Farm marksman form spends Flow on piercing attacks, with a repositioning shot and an area projectile barrage.
guide: ["Use Convergence to recover Flow and reduce skill cooldowns, then keep space behind your allied frontline."]

name: Fuzi
description: A Clash Lane fighter who enhances sustained attacks and confines one enemy to a limited area with Sage's Might.
guide: ["Build Ancient Wisdom through basic attacks and commit your confinement after enemy control abilities are unavailable."]

name: Gan & Mo
description: A Mid mage whose paired flying swords mark enemies with Sword Energy to strengthen subsequent sword hits.
guide: ["Focus flying sword casts on the same exposed target so later hits benefit from its Sword Energy mark."]

name: Gao
description: A Mid mage who combines bouncing notes, enhanced attacks and close-range musical damage with recovery and damage reduction.
guide: ["Use String Bender hits on enemy heroes for recovery and time Rock Out! for sustained nearby combat."]

name: Gao Changgong
description: A Jungle assassin who accelerates toward enemies and uses dagger marks for stuns, recovery and delayed damage.
guide: ["Mark a target before attacking it, and commit after the enemy's key control and defensive abilities are spent."]

name: Garo
description: A Farm marksman who trades mana for extended-range arrows and deals additional damage to enemy shields.
guide: ["Switch out of enhanced arrows to recover mana through attacks, and preserve safe distance behind allied protection."]

name: Guan Yu
description: A Clash Lane fighter whose continuous movement builds a charge that enhances attacks and displacement skills.
guide: ["Maintain movement to reach Charge Stance and account for enemy crowd control before beginning your charge."]

name: Guiguzi
description: A roaming support who camouflages teammates and draws nearby enemies together after a short delay.
guide: ["Coordinate The Animist's delayed pull with allied damage and direct the engage toward a valuable enemy target."]

name: Han Xin
description: A mobile Jungle assassin whose leaps and empowered attacks launch targets, with control immunity during his ultimate.
guide: ["Track enemy control abilities before committing your leaps and use the fourth attack's launch within your sequence."]

name: Haya
description: A Mid mage who spends moon crystals, applies marks and uses repeated hits to add damage or stun enemies.
guide: ["Manage your remaining moon crystals and trigger marks with a second skill hit before resources are exhausted."]

name: Heino
description: A mage fighter for Mid or Clash Lane who changes between melee and ranged modes while using marks to strengthen skills.
guide: ["Hit marked targets to improve Scepter of Fate and account for nearby enemies when Leap of Fate changes your mode."]

name: Hou Yi
description: A Farm marksman who builds attack speed and multi-shot attacks, with a long-range arrow that stuns its target.
guide: ["Fire Burning Sun Arrow when teammates can follow the stun, then attack from behind your frontline."]

name: Huang Zhong
description: A Farm marksman who sets revealing mines and deploys an immobile artillery turret with increased range and defenses.
guide: ["Choose a protected turret position and keep Unleash Your Potential available to leave Turret Mode when threatened."]

name: Jing
description: A Jungle assassin whose mirror image applies a second mark, enabling repeated damage and basic-skill cooldown resets.
guide: ["Combine hits from Jing and her image to trigger both marks, and enter after enemy defensive abilities are committed."]

name: Kaizer
description: A fighter for Clash Lane or Jungle who excels at single-target strikes and gains combat bonuses from demonic armor.
guide: ["Activate Invincible Warrior when allies are positioned to support your engagement and sustain damage during its duration."]

name: Kongming
description: A mage for Mid or Jungle who generates attacking prisms through skill hits and finishes targets with a Spirit Bomb.
guide: ["Build prism stacks through skill hits and aim Winning Strategy at a vulnerable target to earn its cooldown reduction."]

name: Kui
description: A roaming support mage who hooks enemies into range and upgrades his ultimate's slowing hits into stuns against marked targets.
guide: ["Pull a priority enemy with Join Me when allies can follow, then use the mark to strengthen Into the Void."]

name: Lady Sun
description: A Farm marksman who rolls into long-range piercing shots and uses grenades to mark enemies and reduce their defenses.
guide: ["Apply Frag Grenade's mark before attacking and retain a safe rolling direction when enemies attempt to engage."]

name: Lady Zhen
description: A Mid mage who freezes enemies through repeated skill hits and controls areas with icicles and a damaging pool.
guide: ["Chain skill hits onto the intended target to trigger Frozen Touch while teammates are ready to follow."]

name: Lam
description: A Jungle assassin fighter who moves beneath the water, converts marks into healing dashes and deals extra damage to weakened enemies.
guide: ["Enter after enemy defenses are committed and use your marks to sustain the pursuit of a low-health target."]

name: Li Bai
description: A Jungle assassin who unlocks his ultimate through basic attacks and uses an afterimage to return from his dashes.
guide: ["Build the four attack stacks needed for Flickering Flurry and keep track of your Stupor Slash return point."]

name: Li Xin
description: A Clash Lane fighter who changes combat forms, gaining different movement and sword abilities through his transformations.
guide: ["Choose the form needed for the fight and wait for important enemy control abilities before committing."]

name: Lian Po
description: A tank for Clash Lane or Roam whose skill casts resist control and whose Battle Spirit reduces damage during combat.
guide: ["Use Magma Slam near enemies to refresh Burst Ram and begin control sequences when teammates can follow."]

name: Liang
description: A Mid mage who creates barriers and vision-granting magic circles, then suppresses an enemy with Power Word - Control.
guide: ["Select a priority enemy for suppression when allied damage can arrive during the channel."]

name: Liu Bang
description: A tank for Clash Lane or Roam who shields himself, charges into enemies and teleports to protect a teammate.
guide: ["Watch allies for a useful Battlefield Command arrival and coordinate your follow-up stun with their damage."]

name: Liu Bei
description: A Jungle fighter whose repeated attacks increase physical penetration, with a charging knockback and a cleansing defensive ultimate.
guide: ["Follow the initial engagement and time Hearts and Minds to cleanse control while sustaining your attacks."]

name: Liu Shan
description: A roaming support whose control skills disrupt structures, combining shields, launching attacks and area stuns.
guide: ["Start your control sequence when allied attackers are ready to follow, including during pressure on enemy structures."]

name: Lu Bu
description: A Clash Lane fighter whose enchanted weapon adds true damage and healing, with shields and a leaping area launch.
guide: ["Connect Impaling Thrust with a hero to keep your enchantment and time your landing for allied follow-up."]

name: Luban No.7
description: A Farm marksman who unlocks piercing scattershots through attacks or skills and uses rockets and air support for area pressure.
guide: ["Follow skill casts with the enhanced scattershot and retain Shark Cannon's close-range knockback against approaching enemies."]

name: Luna
description: A Jungle fighter whose marked targets let her repeatedly reset New Moon while dashing through the fight.
guide: ["Apply a mark before New Moon and hit the marked enemy to refresh the dash instead of losing the sequence."]

name: Mai Shiranui
description: A mobile Mid assassin who restores energy on skill hits and chains fans, launching strikes and rolling movement.
guide: ["Land KACHOUSEN to weaken a target's magical defense and preserve your commitment until enemy control is spent."]

name: Marco Polo
description: A Farm marksman whose repeated hits trigger true damage, with mobility and skill projectile counts that scale with attack speed.
guide: ["Build Chain Reaction stacks through attacks and skill hits while keeping a safe route for Roaming Gun."]

name: Mayene
description: A fighter for Clash Lane or Jungle who spends Strength on combination attacks that can launch enemies or recover health.
guide: ["Wait for a safe combo opening and pause movement when needed to improve Strength and health recovery."]

name: Meng Ya
description: A Farm marksman who builds Anger through attacks and sustained fire, enhancing skills and recovering health when fully charged.
guide: ["Maintain hits to build Anger, then use the Excited state to strengthen your barrage from behind allied protection."]

name: Menki
description: A fighter for Jungle or Clash Lane who gains Mass from skills, increasing attack and defenses while using shields and dream bubbles.
guide: ["Build Mass through skill use and account for enemy control before committing Dream Roam's landing."]

name: Mi Yue
description: A Clash Lane or Jungle mage who summons healing shadow servants and drains a tethered enemy's attack power.
guide: ["Maintain Ravenous Tether for sustained recovery and use Dark Transfer's second cast to reposition near your shadow."]

name: Milady
description: A Mid mage who summons mechanical attackers and marks enemies or structures to empower nearby minions.
guide: ["Place mechanical minions near the intended target before Chaos Field enhances their attacks."]

name: Ming
description: A roaming support who links to allies for offensive bonuses or enemies to weaken defenses, with health-based healing or damage.
guide: ["Maintain the appropriate link and time support for your teammate's damage window rather than using it too early."]

name: Mozi
description: A Mid or Roam mage who gains shields through skills and combines ranged shell stuns with close-range repeated control.
guide: ["Land Cannon Blast on a priority target when allies can follow and preserve positioning for your next control effect."]

name: Mulan
description: A Clash Lane fighter whose dual-sword attacks build marks that detonate for damage, silence and a slow.
guide: ["Build marks during a safe opening and hold your commitment until key enemy defensive abilities are spent."]

name: Musashi
description: A fighter for Jungle or Clash Lane who spends Vigor on enhanced attacks and can knock down projectiles or delay enemy recovery.
guide: ["Alternate skills with Vigor-enhanced attacks and choose your duel after enemy control abilities have been used."]

name: Nakoruru
description: A Jungle assassin who marks a target for extra damage and cooldown reduction while using dashes that restore health.
guide: ["Apply AMUBE YATORO's mark before dealing follow-up damage and wait for a safe opening before diving."]

name: Nezha
description: A Clash Lane fighter who burns enemies, weakens their recovery and gains map-wide pursuit through Universe Ring.
guide: ["Use Universe Ring's vision to choose your target and account for enemy control before committing Skyfall."]

name: Nuwa
description: A Mid mage who creates blocking matrices, teleports across the battlefield and projects a damaging line across the map.
guide: ["Use your other skills to detonate matrices and preserve enough mana for a sustained fight."]

name: Pei
description: A Jungle assassin who changes between ranged human attacks and a mobile tiger form, recovering Energy through hits.
guide: ["Recover Energy with human-form attacks and enter with tiger form after opposing defensive abilities are committed."]

name: Sakeer
description: A roaming support whose fireflies reveal and damage enemies or heal teammates, with movement tied to brush.
guide: ["Use brush for Ride the Wind and direct Mulberry Power's launch toward a target allies can immediately pressure."]

name: Shangguan
description: A Mid mage whose interacting ink skills restore health and allow repeated dashes before an untargetable finishing sequence.
guide: ["Trace Finishing Stroke through enemies or existing ink to continue its dashes after opposing control is spent."]

name: Shi
description: A Mid mage who deals more damage from farther away and redirects enemies through Silk Imprint's pull.
guide: ["Use Silk Imprint to move a valuable target toward allied damage and combine it with your energy orb."]

name: Shouyue
description: A Farm marksman who prepares attack marks out of combat, places scouting devices and threatens targets with long-range sniping.
guide: ["Place The Tranquil Eye for information and keep Getaway available when enemies reach your position."]

name: Sima Yi
description: An assassin for Jungle or Mid who senses nearby skill users, advances through a spirit and silences enemies around him.
guide: ["Wait for opposing control to be used, then combine your approach with Barren Lands' silence."]

name: Sun Bin
description: A roaming support who accelerates teammates, restores part of recent damage and disrupts enemies with delayed time bombs.
guide: ["Activate Time Flux during incoming damage and coordinate Time Lapse's silence with allied pressure."]

name: Sun Ce
description: A fighter for Clash Lane or Jungle who builds defenses through combat and pilots a control-immune boat that carries an ally.
guide: ["Coordinate Set Sail! with a teammate and aim the arrival where allies can follow your crowd control."]

name: Ukyo Tachibana
description: An assassin for Jungle or Clash Lane who gains ranged healing attacks and uses precise slashes to stun at their edge.
guide: ["Aim Heavenly Hack's outer range for its stun and commit only after important enemy control abilities are unavailable."]

name: Umbrosa
description: A fighter for Clash Lane or Jungle who rebounds featherblades at range and switches to faster melee attacks up close.
guide: ["Return featherblades toward marked targets and use Feathered Tempest to trigger and spread their marks."]

name: Wang Wei
description: A Mid mage who gathers protective mist marks and combines lingering damage zones with knockback and relocation.

name: Wang Zhaojun
description: A Mid mage who gains an icy shield, freezes enemies after a delay and controls space with a persistent snowstorm.
guide: ["Follow Frigid Prison's freeze with damage and place Winter Is Here where enemies remain within the area."]

name: Wukong
description: A Jungle assassin whose skills empower his next attack into a dash strike, with a defensive skill block and area launch.
guide: ["Time Protective Shroud for an incoming enemy skill and follow your own skill casts with enhanced attacks."]

name: Wuyan
description: A fighter for Clash Lane or Jungle whose attacks may petrify enemies and whose spinning hammer supplies shields and mobility.
guide: ["Enter when allies can follow your crowd control and keep enemies within Hurricane Hammer's damage area."]

name: Xiang Yu
description: A tank for Roam or Clash Lane who gains strength at low health and combines charging displacement with reduced enemy damage.
guide: ["Direct Righteous Fervor toward a priority enemy when teammates are ready to capitalize on the launch."]

name: Xiao Qiao
description: A Mid mage who gains movement from skill hits and combines a returning fan, an area launch and nearby meteor strikes.
guide: ["Aim the fan to hit on both paths and preserve enough mana to combine control with your damaging skills."]

name: Xuance
description: A Jungle assassin who marks enemies with a hook, manipulates their position and dashes around the marked target.
guide: ["Secure a hook mark before the follow-up pull and commit after opposing control and defensive abilities are used."]

name: Yang Jian
description: A fighter for Clash Lane or Jungle who builds Resistance, follows a marked hound target and heals through damaging beams.
guide: ["Mark your target before using the follow-up charge and time your attack after enemy control abilities are spent."]

name: Yango
description: An assassin for Clash Lane or Jungle who controls a puppet and collects hero shards, with a cleansing relocation skill.
guide: ["Track enemy control before deploying the puppet and preserve Dispersal for a useful cleanse or reposition."]

name: Yao
description: A fighter for Jungle or Clash Lane who enhances every fourth skill, heals through hits and returns to his recent location.
guide: ["Track your three-skill enhancement cycle and remember the earlier position that Return to Dust will restore."]

name: Yaria
description: A roaming support who can attach to an ally, providing a shield against true damage while strengthening her own abilities.
guide: ["Attach during a teammate's damage window and detach voluntarily when useful to shorten the next attachment cooldown."]

name: Ying
description: A Jungle fighter whose skill casts empower her next attack and reduce basic-skill cooldowns when that attack is used.
guide: ["Weave Spear Will attacks between skills and account for enemy control before beginning Starburn's dash sequence."]

name: Yixing
description: A Mid mage who places Weiqi stones for vision and damage, then uses formations to draw enemies into a confined area.
guide: ["Place stones before Taking Liberties so they move into its formation while allies prepare follow-up damage."]

name: Yuhuan
description: A mage for Mid or Roam who switches melodies between nearby damage and allied healing, with delayed area control.
guide: ["Choose the Peace melody when allies need recovery and time Unending Sorrow around incoming damage."]

name: Zhang Fei
description: A roaming support who builds Madness while protecting allies, then transforms with a disruptive roar and a large shield.
guide: ["Build Madness through hits and allied shields, then transform when your teammates can follow the roar's control."]

name: Zhou Yu
description: A Mid mage who spreads persistent fires with wind, damages structures through stacked burns and heals while standing in fire.
guide: ["Place Scorching Bolt before spreading the flames with Wildfire, then use Flames of War across a fire domain."]

name: Zhuangzi
description: A support for Roam or Clash Lane who periodically clears control and can cleanse nearby teammates while granting shields.
guide: ["Time Butterfly Effect to remove allied crowd control and engage when your team can maintain damage."]

name: Zilong
description: A Jungle fighter assassin who becomes tougher as health falls and combines charging strikes, recovery and an area launch.
guide: ["Use a gap-closing skill to reach a priority target and center Skysplitter for its launch."]

name: Ziya
description: A mage for Mid or Roam who gains experience from recently damaged targets and combines weakening seals with delayed area control.
guide: ["Use Divine Seal to reduce enemy defenses and follow with Divine Punishment while managing your remaining mana."]
